title: Elder problem: salt fingers sinking under their own weight
source: Elder (1967), Voss and Souza (1987); compared with the official OGS benchmark output (Parabolic/ComponentTransport/elder) on the same 128 x 64 grid
note: half domain: the right side (x = 300 m) is the symmetry line of the classic 600 m model. The official input is a one-element-thick 3D slab; this case builds a 2D model from the model tree. The fields agree within 2.5 % at 1, 2 and 4 years (largest point difference 2.3 %). On this grid both runs, ours and the official one, dip below zero next to the fingers (to -0.21 at 4 years), an undershoot of the unstabilised Galerkin method; the answer card reports such values as a warning.
